name: Extra Familiar
body:
You can acquire more than one familiar

Prerequisite: Ability to acquire a familiar.

Benefit: You gain a second familiar.

Special: A witch taking second familiar must keep track of which familiar knows which spells as each must be taught separately. A spell may be taught to more than one familiar, but each familiar does not automatically know the spells learned by the others.
